cuts.ofreeRecent: a circus tent ring under a striped canopy — standing; a retro American diner — holds a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw at chest height; a convention photo zone under ring lights — raises a camera to her eye to take a photo; the nave of a Gothic cathedral with stained-glass windows — sitting on the ground; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — brings a cup to her lips; overgrown jungle temple ruins — holds a small bouquet at chest height; an airport lounge — sips a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw through the straw; a desert oasis at golden hour — standing; a fashion runway under white spotlights — kneeling on the ground; a steaming outdoor hot spring among rocks and bamboo — perched on a ledge or edge; the moat path beneath the old Jingzhou city wall at dusk — sitting on the ground; a quiet library reading room with tall bookshelves — standing; a private karaoke room with spinning coloured lights — seated on a chair
